item.title: Bulletin updated at 16:30 HKT 16/Feb/2025
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A fresh to strong northeast monsoon will affect the coast of southern China in the next couple of days. A band of clouds will cover Guangdong midweek this week. A replenishment of the northeast monsoon is expected to affect southern China in the latter part of this week. It will be cool in the morning and at night over the region during the weekend to early next week.

Weather: Cloudy periods in the morning. Visibility rather low in some areas. Mainly fine and dry during the day.
Temp range: 17 - 21 C
R.H. range: 50 - 85 per Cent
